headline: QwenPaw Index

benchmarkNotes.gaia: We evaluate all 165 GAIA validation tasks through Harbor and ACP, using normalized answer matching and counting tasks without valid scores as zero. The official main leaderboard uses the test split, while this board uses the public validation split. No LLM judge is used.
benchmarkNotes.spreadsheetbench-verified: We evaluate 400 SpreadsheetBench V1 Verified tasks by comparing target cells after LibreOffice recalculation, counting tasks without valid scores as zero. The official V1 Full set contains 912 tasks; this board uses its Verified subset. Scoring is programmatic and uses no LLM judge.
benchmarkNotes.swebench-verified: We evaluate all 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks by applying agent patches and running repository tests, reporting resolution rate with tasks without valid scores counted as zero. We use the SWE-bench Verified task set and test scoring through Harbor and ACP, with internet access enabled. No LLM judge is used.
benchmarkNotes.pawbench: We evaluate 150 PawBench v1.0 tasks, preserving their programmatic and model-judge weights and averaging task scores with tasks without valid scores counted as zero. This board uses qwen3.8-max for model judging, while the officially published results use Claude Opus 4.6. The judge-model difference is part of the comparison settings.

runBudget: Context limit: {{contextTokens}} tokens · Output limit: {{output}} tokens
partialCostNote: Costs include recorded model calls only, excluding judge costs and unrecorded consumption; they are not reconciled invoice totals. Scores, costs and runtimes use the selected benchmark weights. Runtime includes environment preparation and scoring.
guideIntro: Find the right QwenPaw SDK, mode and model for research, spreadsheet work, code repair and general agent tasks.
guideCompare: Start with the domain closest to your work, then compare SDK versions, Default, Goal and Code modes, and models. The overall Index weights each benchmark at 25%; close tabs, add benchmarks or edit their shares to match your priorities.
guideMetrics: Scores average task-level results within each benchmark, then apply the selected weights. Valid verifier scores are retained even if execution reports an error; tasks without valid scores contribute zero. The chart uses recorded model costs only, excluding judge costs; runtime includes environment preparation and scoring.
shareHelp: Other benchmarks keep their relative proportions and share the remaining weight.
singleBenchmarkWeight: A single selected benchmark has a 100% share. Add another benchmark to change this share.
invalidShare: Enter a share greater than 0% and less than 100%.

gaia.purpose: Find and combine information across sources, browse the web and work with files to answer factual questions.
gaia.scope: All 165 tasks in the public GAIA validation split. The official main leaderboard evaluates the test split.
gaia.scoring: Normalized answer matching; no model judge.

spreadsheetbench-verified.purpose: Edit real spreadsheets: transform data, apply formulas and deliver the required workbook changes.
spreadsheetbench-verified.scope: The 400-task expert-verified V1 subset, drawn from the original 912-task SpreadsheetBench release.
spreadsheetbench-verified.scoring: Compare target cells after LibreOffice recalculation; no model judge.

swebench-verified.purpose: Resolve real GitHub issues by navigating repositories, changing code and validating patches.
swebench-verified.scope: All 500 human-validated SWE-bench Verified tasks, executed through Harbor and ACP with network access.
swebench-verified.scoring: Apply the submitted patch and run repository tests; report the percentage of resolved issues.

pawbench.purpose: Complete varied agent workflows involving tools, skills, information retrieval and artifact delivery.
pawbench.scope: All 150 PawBench v1.0 tasks in the evaluated task bundle.
pawbench.scoring: Preserve per-task programmatic and model-grading weights. This Index uses qwen3.8-max as model judge; the official release uses Claude Opus 4.6.

guideFuture: We plan to add benchmarks across more domains, with harder and longer-horizon tasks, to bring version, mode and model comparisons closer to real work. Stay tuned.
guideCommunity: Suggest a domain or task in the QwenPaw community
